h:
v1.0 base

一个Cosxl的基础工作流，加入了高清修复和face detailer，civitai没有上传CosXL模型，所以，这个工作流其实就是目前用来展示图片用的，如果有需要下载用的，推荐使用karras调度器来提升图片美观度

CosXL的下载URL：

选择性的添加RescaleCFG，FreeU_V2 /(Advanced)，能改善生图效果，我在部分示例图中使用了

使用Ksampler（advanced）对图片进行放大并添加细节，同时增加色阶增强及部分PS功能，来发挥CosXL模型的色彩优势

o.en:
A Cosxl basic workflow, adding HD repair and face detailer, civitai did not upload CosXL model, so this workflow is actually used to show the picture, if you need to download it, it is recommended to use karras scheduler to improve the image beauty

CosXL download URL:

https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/cosxl

Optionally add RescaleCFG, FreeU_V2 /(Advanced) to improve the image production, which I used in some examples

v2.0 Ksampler HD upscale

Use Ksampler (advanced) to enlarge and add details to the image, while adding color level enhancement and some PS functions to take advantage of the color advantages of the CosXL model
